about_the_game:
🖼️ Terrain Sculpting 

Raise hills, carve valleys, and sculpt flowing rivers and waterfalls. Sculpt landscapes where birds perch, butterflies flutter, and fish swim through winding streams.

🌏 Dynamic World

Enjoy a full day/night cycle with gentle rain, rustling wind, and shifting sunlight. Wildlife and weather bring each moment to life.

🌲 Bioluminescent Forests

As night falls, your woodland transforms into a glowing spectacle. Fireflies dance through the trees, and you're treated to a magical bioluminescent lightshow that brings the forest to life.

🪷 Cosy Creativity

Place trees, flowers, rocks, and more in a world that grows and responds with natural charm. Every addition feels like it belongs.

⛅ Soothing Atmosphere

A calming, no-pressure space to unwind. There are no wrong choices or failure states—only peaceful immersion in nature. You can always change your mind and reshape the world as inspiration strikes.

🎧 Immersive Soundscape

Relax to ambient music woven with the gentle sounds of the forest—chirping birds, flowing water, rustling leaves, and the soft hush of rain.

Let your imagination bloom in Spellbound Shire, a meditative escape where the landscape lives and breathes with every gentle touch.

name: Spellbound Shire Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce RTX 3070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5700X
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce RTX 3070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Audio Device

short_description: A cozy, relaxing landscaping game where nature is your canvas. Shape the land, guide the water, and grow your own enchanted wilderness in Spellbound Shire, a no-stress, meditative experience inspired by Studio Ghibli, Zelda, and the Ori franchise.
